items.title: Where exactly do the buggy and fixed shipping functions disagree?
items.description: Drag the package weight and watch the buggy version (`weight < threshold`) and the fixed version (`weight <= threshold`) compute their price. The default (5.0kg) reproduces the opening scenario's exact case. This interactive focuses only on tier boundaries: 5.00kg and 10.00kg.
items.compute: function buggy(w) { if (w < 5) return 4.99; if (w < 10) return 8.99; return 14.99; } function fixed(w) { if (w <= 5) return 4.99; if (w <= 10) return 8.99; return 14.99; } const buggyCost = buggy(params.weightKg); const fixedCost = fixed(params.weightKg); return { buggyCost, fixedCost, versionsDiffer: buggyCost === fixedCost ? 0 : 1 };
